stories.title: Galaxy Gaming director buys $17,775 in stock
stories.summary: A Galaxy Gaming director named Boushy bought $17,775 of common stock. Investing.com reported the purchase on November 14. The filing does not give a share count or price.
stories.whyItMatters: Insider buying can signal confidence in a company. This purchase is small, so it carries limited weight on its own.
whatToWatch: Future SEC filings from Galaxy Gaming insiders
Whether other directors make similar purchases
questions: What price per share did the director pay?
Is this part of a larger pattern of insider buying at Galaxy Gaming?

stories.title: NEXGEL interim CEO buys $732,688 in stock
stories.summary: NEXGEL interim CEO Brian Kieser bought $732,688 of common stock. Investing.com reported the purchase on November 14. This is a large purchase for a company at NEXGEL's size.
stories.whyItMatters: A large buy by an interim CEO is a stronger signal than a routine insider purchase. Readers tracking NEXGEL should note the size of this stake.
whatToWatch: Whether NEXGEL names a permanent CEO
questions: What drove the size of this purchase?
Does the board plan to confirm Kieser as permanent CEO?

stories.title: NEXGEL director buys $25,003 in common stock
stories.summary: NEXGEL director Steven Glassman bought $25,003 of common stock. Investing.com reported the purchase on November 14. This filing follows a much larger purchase by NEXGEL's interim CEO on the same day.
stories.whyItMatters: Multiple insiders buying stock around the same time can add weight to a confidence signal, even when each purchase is modest.
whatToWatch: Whether the pattern of insider buying continues
questions: Is this purchase coordinated with the CEO's larger buy, or a coincidence?

stories.title: Carl Icahn sells $33.7 million of Centuri Holdings stock
stories.summary: Carl Icahn, a Centuri Holdings director, sold $33.7 million of company stock. Investing.com reported the sale on November 14. The filing does not state Icahn's reason for the sale or his remaining stake.
stories.whyItMatters: Icahn is a high-profile activist investor, so large sales by him draw market attention and can shape views on a stock's outlook.
whatToWatch: Whether Icahn reports further sales of Centuri Holdings stock
